# Open Source Initiative

> The Open Source Initiative (OSI) stewards the Open Source Definition, approves open source licenses, and advocates for open source software and AI.

OSI is a nonprofit organization focused on defining, protecting, and promoting open source through policy, education, license review, and community governance. Its site includes the Open Source Definition, approved licenses, the Open Source AI Definition, news, and organizational information.

## Core Definitions
- [The Open Source Definition](https://opensource.org/osd): The canonical definition used to determine whether a software license is open source.
- [Open Source AI](https://opensource.org/ai): OSI’s hub for the Open Source AI Definition, background, and related materials.
- [Open Source AI Definition 1.0](https://opensource.org/ai/open-source-ai-definition): Defines criteria for AI systems to qualify as open source.
- [Open Source AI Definition 1.0 RC2](https://opensource.org/ai/open-source-ai-definition/1-0-rc2): Release candidate text and criteria preceding the final AI definition.
- [Open Source AI Definition 1.0 RC1](https://opensource.org/ai/open-source-ai-definition/1-0-rc1): Earlier release candidate for the Open Source AI Definition.
- [Open Source Principles](https://opensource.org/open-source-principles): OSI’s principles-oriented resource explaining open source values and expectations.

## Licenses and License Review
- [Licenses & Standards](https://opensource.org/licenses): Main entry point for approved licenses and licensing standards.
- [Open Source Licenses by Category](https://opensource.org/licenses/category): Browse approved licenses grouped by family or category.
- [Open Source Licenses by Name](https://opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical): Browse approved licenses in alphabetical order.
- [Open Source Licenses by Popularity](https://opensource.org/licenses/popular): Browse commonly used approved open source licenses.
- [License Review Process](https://opensource.org/approval): Explains how licenses are submitted and reviewed for OSI approval.
- [Open Standards Requirement](https://opensource.org/osr): Describes OSI’s Open Standards Requirement and related criteria.

## Education and Guides
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://opensource.org/faq): Answers common questions about open source, licensing, and OSI’s role.
- [Open Source Basics](https://opensource.org/open-source-basics): Introductory material explaining open source concepts for newcomers.
- [Open Source for Business](https://opensource.org/open-source-for-business): Explains how organizations use and benefit from open source.
- [Open Source and Education](https://opensource.org/open-source-education): Educational perspective on open source learning and participation.
- [Openwashing](https://opensource.org/openwashing): Explains misleading claims about openness and how to identify them.
- [Open Source 101](https://opensource.org/open-source-101): Foundational overview of open source history, practice, and terminology.

## Policy and Advocacy
- [Policy Activities](https://opensource.org/policy-activities): Overview of OSI’s public policy and advocacy work.
- [Open Future](https://opensource.org/open-future): OSI initiative focused on protecting openness in emerging technology and policy.
- [AI Policy](https://opensource.org/ai/policy): Policy-related work and positions concerning open source AI.
- [About Open Source AI](https://opensource.org/ai/about): Background on OSI’s work to define and support open source AI.
- [Deep Dive: Open Source AI](https://opensource.org/deepdive-ai): In-depth analysis and discussion of open source AI issues.
- [Position Papers](https://opensource.org/tag/position-paper): Collection of OSI position papers and formal statements.

## News and Articles
- [Blog](https://opensource.org/blog): OSI news, announcements, commentary, and community updates.
- [Press Room](https://opensource.org/press): Press releases, media resources, and official announcements.
- [News Tag Archive](https://opensource.org/tag/news): Tagged archive of news-related posts and updates.
- [License Tag Archive](https://opensource.org/tag/license): Articles and updates related to licensing topics.
- [Open Source AI Tag Archive](https://opensource.org/tag/open-source-ai): Posts covering the Open Source AI Definition and related work.
- [Openwashing Tag Archive](https://opensource.org/tag/openwashing): Articles discussing openwashing and misleading openness claims.

## Community and Programs
- [Membership](https://opensource.org/membership): Information about joining OSI and supporting its mission.
- [Affiliates](https://opensource.org/affiliates): Directory and information about OSI affiliate organizations.
- [Board of Directors](https://opensource.org/board-of-directors): Current board members and governance leadership information.
- [Staff](https://opensource.org/staff): OSI staff directory and organizational roles.
- [Volunteers](https://opensource.org/volunteers): Information on volunteer participation and community contribution.
- [Events](https://opensource.org/events): OSI events, appearances, and community gatherings.

## Organization and Governance
- [About OSI](https://opensource.org/about): Overview of OSI’s mission, history, and organizational purpose.
- [Mission](https://opensource.org/mission): Statement of OSI’s mission and strategic focus.
- [Bylaws](https://opensource.org/bylaws): Governing bylaws for the Open Source Initiative organization.
- [Code of Conduct](https://opensource.org/codeofconduct): Community behavior expectations for OSI spaces and events.
- [Elections](https://opensource.org/elections): Information about OSI board elections and governance participation.
- [Contact](https://opensource.org/contact): Contact information and ways to reach the organization.

## Resources and Support
- [Donate](https://opensource.org/donate): Ways to financially support OSI’s work and programs.
- [Sponsors](https://opensource.org/sponsors): Organizations supporting OSI through sponsorship.
- [Store](https://opensource.org/store): OSI merchandise and branded items.
- [Privacy Policy](https://opensource.org/privacy): Privacy practices governing use of the OSI website and services.
- [Terms of Service](https://opensource.org/terms): Terms governing use of the website and related services.
